clippings.speaker: Kevin Williamson
clippings.quote: So, here is the director of the movie, in the middle of his stressful, busy first day giving this novice kid from Goose Creek a master class in building tension.
clippings.title: 'Scream' Writer Kevin Williamson Pens Tribute to Wes Craven: He Gave Me "a Master Class in Building Tension"
clippings.context: From Williamson's written tribute after Craven's death, recalling the first day of shooting Drew Barrymore's opening scene; quoted by Out from THR.

clippings.speaker: Kevin Williamson
clippings.quote: Scream changed my life forever… Knowing Wes Craven changed my life forever. I am grateful. I am blessed.
clippings.title: 'Scream' Writer Kevin Williamson Pens Tribute to Wes Craven: He Gave Me "a Master Class in Building Tension"
clippings.context: Closing lines of Williamson's THR tribute to Craven, as quoted by Out.

clippings.speaker: Kevin Williamson
clippings.quote: I got to pick the brain of Wes Craven. Not just that, I had a really long relationship and really great friendship. He was a mentor and friend to me and also a co-conspirator for many years. So I got my dream, my dream did come true.
clippings.title: Scream Writer Kevin Williamson Reflects on the Franchise's Legacy and Connecting With Fans
clippings.context: Asked for the 25th anniversary which filmmaker he would have wanted to learn from.

clippings.speaker: Kevin Williamson
clippings.quote: Wes created a very family environment. You felt like you were safe, and that you were with your uncle or your father or somebody.
clippings.title: Your Favorite Scary Movie: The Oral History of 'Scream'
clippings.context: Williamson in The Ringer's 25th-anniversary oral history, on the atmosphere of the 1996 shoot.

clippings.speaker: Wes Craven
clippings.quote: Scream is a great example of something that is very innovative and has drawn top talent, inspired by great scripts written by Kevin. It has allowed me to do some of my best work and most popular work. Kevin is a great writer, and I love doing his material.
clippings.title: Constant Craven: The Franchise that Doesn't Die (Unlike Everyone In It)
clippings.context: Craven interviewed by Steven Prigge ahead of Scream 4, asked whether he had grown to enjoy horror.

clippings.speaker: Wes Craven
clippings.quote: It was the result of Kevin's original master script, and Ehren did a decent amount of work on specific scenes and areas of it. I also wrote sections of the film myself. But, it very much is Kevin's concept, characters, situations and over-arcing framework for the film.
clippings.title: Wes Craven Interview SCREAM 4
clippings.context: At the Scream 4 press day, responding to talk of Ehren Kruger's rewrites of Williamson's script.
